# agenco_application (Data Source)

Looks up an existing Frontegg application by ID or by name. Exactly one of the two is required.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "agenco_application" "storefront" {
  name = "Storefront"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Application ID. Set this or name.
- `name` (String) Application name. Set this or id.

### Read-Only

- `access_type` (String) Access type.
- `allow_dcr` (Boolean) Whether Dynamic Client Registration is allowed.
- `app_host` (String) Host assigned by Frontegg.
- `app_url` (String) URL the application is served from.
- `description` (String) Application description.
- `frontend_stack` (String) Frontend stack.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the application is active.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the default application.
- `login_url` (String) Login URL.
- `logo_url` (String) Logo URL.
- `type` (String) Application type.
- `vendor_id` (String) Vendor that owns the application.
